title: Demonic Guardian and Blue Oni
description: A surreal dark scene features a large ornate red and gold Japanese demon mask with glowing eyes and horns floating above a purple patterned floor. To its right stands a small angry blue oni creature with golden floral patterns, while a stylized woman's profile silhouette appears on the left within a swirling red and yellow spiral eye motif.
